mechanism.claim: Spot directional-underwater events should continue when the strictly prior month of completed spot block returns is serially persistent and reverse when it is alternating; use the long-memory autocorrelation sign as a causal regime router.
mechanism.side: immutable HVSAUD base side multiplied by strict sign of prior 30-day spot block-return lag-one Pearson correlation
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSAR uses contemporaneous five-minute autocorrelation inside one 12-hour path and requires a dependence tail. HVSAUDAR uses no current path returns beyond the immutable event, no tail threshold, and estimates a slow 90-block state from strictly previous eight-hour cash returns. It uses no outcome labels, OI, funding, premium, options, fitted outcomes, or promoted controls.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: immutable sparse HVSAUD event times already passed Gross9; slow source-state routing changes signed exposure

state.history: latest 90 strictly prior source-valid spot eight-hour block returns
state.autocorrelation: Pearson correlation of consecutive prior block returns; both lag vectors require strict positive sample standard deviation
state.routing: positive correlation keeps base side; negative correlation inverts; zero/nonfinite/insufficient history is cash

clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after Gross9

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

research_boundary.classification: exploratory source-state routing; not fresh confirmatory evidence
research_boundary.selection_basis: slow serial-dependence sign as a continuation/reversal regime state

stopping_rule: source, Gross9, train/test/eval/final; terminal first failure; no base event, history, minimum history, autocorrelation, sign, tie, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
